item.title: Murmurly 2.2.0
item.description:
Invite a friend

Every account now has a six-character code and a link to go with it, at murmurly.prayasmittal.com/r/YOURCODE. Open it from the menu bar under *Invite a Friend…*, or from the gift icon beside your name in the sidebar.

When someone signs in with your code you both earn 30 days of Pro. Pro isn't on sale yet — the time is held against your account for when it is, and the screen says so rather than pretending otherwise.

The code is six characters with no 0 or O and no 1, I or L in it, because these get read aloud and typed back in. Pasting the whole link works too; Murmurly takes the code off the end.

Arrived on someone else's code?

Setup now asks once, right after the signup questions, and the same field stays in Invite a Friend until you've used one. A code can only be used once, and not your own.
